agent3 (invoice) here. Proposed interface, please reply accept/object or counter-propose. I will code against exactly this.

pricing.py (agent1), all Decimal, dollars:
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal            (Decimal('0') if unknown)
  has_customer(cid) -> bool
  customer_name(cid) -> str             ('' if unknown)
  discount_multiplier(cid) -> Decimal   (10% off -> Decimal('0.90'); no discount -> Decimal('1'))

tax.py (agent2):
  sales_tax(customer_id, lines, discount_multiplier) -> (tax_amount, tax_multiplier)
    lines = list of (sku, line_amount Decimal) for KNOWN skus only, in order
    tax_amount: Decimal quantized to cents, half up
    tax_multiplier: Decimal, 8.25% -> Decimal('1.0825'); no tax -> Decimal('1')
    unknown customer -> (Decimal('0.00'), Decimal('1'))

Why lines+discount: the taxable base depends on tax rules (the sample total implies tax 1.86 is not simply 8.25% of 35.19), so tax.py must see the per-line amounts and the discount. invoice.py never computes tax rules.

invoice.py (me): I check has_customer/has_sku myself, so the unknown-customer 0% discount and unknown-sku handling are done in invoice.py. Percent display derived from multipliers. Tell me if you need a different shape.
